title: Manager pacing: replace the wrong budget doctrine with the real mandate; wire the EXISTING spend meter into the check-in; make the toolbox findable
note: REVISED 2026-10-18 ~09:45Z after operator correction. The first version proposed a hard 2-lane cap, a new meter and a write-every-correction rule; all three were rejected. THE MANDATE (operator, verbatim): 'We want to get as much work as possible out of our budget without blowing through it before a reset - that is the mandate.' At least one lane always runs; up to 5 by judgment, depending on spare capacity and what the lanes are doing. Hard limits only bound the error; they do not make a manager do the job. ROOT CAUSES: (1) The manager SKILL.md budget section ('The budget - DAILY, and spend it') teaches the opposite of the mandate: 'spend the daily budget', 'passing into the margin is authorized', 'the weekly bar is not the manager's meter', 'dispatch in parallel', and Fable as a free second pool. The section-5 footer of scripts/ops/spend_meter.py repeats the same doctrine. (2) The meter EXISTS: scripts/ops/spend_meter.py (A1, built 2026-09-21, guard spend-meter-guard). The manager skill never names it, and docs/claude/work/USAGE-READINGS.jsonl had ZERO readings before 2026-10-18. Today's manager proposed rebuilding it. That is a findability failure, not a missing tool. (3) The skill is 81 KB, and the operating loop a manager actually needs is buried in it. BUILD (one small Sonnet lane): (a) Replace the budget section with the mandate above plus the pacing loop. At each check-in, record the operator's latest reading via spend_meter.py --record, compute (100 - weekly%) / days-to-reset as the sustainable rate, and pick 1-5 lanes for that rate and what is queued. No fixed cap. (b) Fix the section-5 footer of spend_meter.py to state the same mandate. (c) Add a short 'Toolbox' table near the top of the manager skill, one line each, for the existing tools a manager needs: spend_meter, checklist.py, mandate_resolver, roadmap_map, live_vs_backtest, the merge recipe. Net skill length goes DOWN. NOT IN SCOPE: hard caps, a new meter, a rule that codifies every operator remark. DONE WHEN merged, and the next manager check-in records a reading and states its lane count against the computed rate. LANE MANAGER-OPERATING-LOOP-1018 (2026-10-18, scope widened by the manager's dispatch): built manager SKILL.md § 'The operating loop' (INTAKE / CAPACITY / DISPATCH / LAND / CLOSE / REPORT + Toolbox), Start of session step 0 points at it; retired the 'spend it' / parallel-dispatch / hourly / Fable-as-free doctrine (skill 81,111 -> 80,797 bytes); priority_rank is now the declared queue field (checklist.py add --rank, set priority_rank=N, checklist.py queue; Overview 'next' serves the ranked queue); spend_meter.py --capacity computes (100 - weekly%) / days to reset -> 1-5 lanes; guard manager-pacing-guard. MEASURED at build: 153 runnable rows, only 4 carry a priority_rank -- ranking them is the manager's step-1 work. DONE WHEN: merged, AND the manager's 'Manager lane check-in' routine prompt is reduced to 'run the operating loop (manager SKILL.md § The operating loop)' AND its next check-in records a usage reading and states its lane count against the --capacity rate. ADDED same PR (manager trigger 2026-10-18 ~11:55Z, operator: archive only this project's sessions): lane_reconcile.archive_eligible -- eligible on a project repo, the project env env_01A9rfUVrcEo1i5pKP1kWnp3, or a checklist lane/lane_history or manager: tag; a foreign repo is NEVER eligible; non-eligible finished sessions render as LEFT ALONE. Self-test wired as lane-reconcile-guard; Archive protocol step 0 + loop step 5 state it.  [2026-10-22 17:55Z manager session_01Hsp3aD8ccAyhHiyYARqEqh] #18959 MERGED; the operating loop + priority_rank queue + archive_eligible are live in .claude/skills/manager/SKILL.md (read this session) and used by every manager since 10-18. Lane archived. done.
